title: Codex × Blender：用一句話操控 3D 軟體
learning_goal: 看完後能說出 Codex 操控 Blender 的兩條路（背景腳本、MCP 即時連線）與 MCP 迴路「指令 → Python → MCP → Blender 外掛 → 截圖回饋」，並能用 codex mcp add 接上 Blender、用一句話建出場景後先檢查再修改。

approval.evidence: 2026-10-11 對話：使用者回覆「正式製作」，回應「樣片和大綱可以照這樣進入正式製作嗎？」（樣片 v1：MCP 迴路 18.5 秒；大綱 v1 八幕）

origin.summary: Codex 原本看不到 Blender；MCP（2024-11）提供開放標準；2025 年 3 月社群 BlenderMCP 讓 AI 透過外掛操作 Blender；2026 年 4 月 Blender 官方 MCP；Codex 支援 MCP。
origin.event_type: 首次實作公開（社群 BlenderMCP）

principle.summary: 兩條路：blender -b -P 背景腳本 vs MCP 即時連線，核心皆為 bpy；MCP 迴路：一句話→Python→MCP→外掛（localhost:9876、無認證）→執行→截圖→修正；四個設定步驟。

comparison.summary: 同一任務比較背景腳本、MCP for Blender（社群）、Blender Lab MCP（官方）的開啟需求、外掛、版本、即時性、維護者與風險。
comparison.conditions: 同一任務（建木凳並算圖）、本機 Windows、Blender 5.2.1；只比較原理與適用性，非效能實測

application.summary: 應用一：一句話建書房角落，Blender 5.2.1 背景模式實際算出兩版（第二版加暖光），限制為牆上怪影與美感判斷；應用二：120 個 Cube 批次改名 Book_###、套材質、匯出 GLB，實測 13.4 秒、176 KB，搭配三個安全習慣。

outlook.summary: 已公布：官方 Blender MCP 上架、Anthropic 捐款支持 Python API；未解：靠截圖理解 3D、執行程式的安全風險；推測：更多創作軟體開放 MCP。

scenes.title: 起源：Codex 需要一座橋
scenes.screen: 2024-11 MCP 標準 → 2025 年 3 月 社群 BlenderMCP → 2026 年 4 月 Blender 官方 MCP
scenes.objective: 知道 Codex 本身看不到 Blender，需要 MCP 這座橋；記住 2025 年 3 月社群 BlenderMCP、2026 年 4 月官方 MCP
scenes.narration: 想用一句話，就在 Blender 裡蓋出一個場景嗎？問題是，Codex 本來看不到 Blender，也按不到它的任何按鈕。它需要一座橋。2024 年 11 月，Anthropic 提出 MCP，一種讓 AI 連接外部工具的開放標準；2025 年 3 月，社群開發者 Siddharth Ahuja 發布 BlenderMCP，讓 AI 透過外掛直接操作 Blender；2026 年 4 月，Blender 官方團隊也推出了自己的 MCP 伺服器。Codex 支援 MCP，所以這座橋，Codex 也能走。

scenes.title: 原理一：兩條路
scenes.screen: 背景腳本：寫好 .py 交給 Blender 跑｜MCP：Blender 開著，邊做邊看
scenes.objective: 分辨背景腳本與 MCP 即時連線兩條路，並知道兩者核心都是 bpy
scenes.narration: Codex 操控 Blender，有兩條路。第一條是背景腳本：Codex 寫好一個 Python 檔，在終端機用 Blender 的背景模式執行它；Blender 不開視窗，跑完就結束。它適合批次、可以重複的工作，但過程中你看不到畫面。第二條是 MCP 即時連線：Blender 開著，Codex 一邊下指令、一邊看結果；適合邊做邊調整，代價是 Blender 必須開著，還要先裝好外掛。兩條路的核心都一樣：Codex 寫 Python，交給 Blender 內建的 bpy 去執行。

scenes.title: 原理二：MCP 迴路
scenes.screen: 一句話 → Python → MCP 送進 Blender 外掛 → 執行 → 截圖回饋 → 修正
scenes.objective: 能依序說出 MCP 迴路，並知道 9876 埠無密碼的風險
scenes.narration: 你說一句話，Codex 就把它寫成 Python；MCP 把程式送進 Blender 裡的外掛，外掛執行程式，場景裡就長出物件；Codex 再看截圖檢查，哪裡不對，就再改一次。MCP 伺服器提供的工具，例如執行程式碼、讀取場景資訊、看視窗截圖，就是 Codex 的手和眼睛。要注意，外掛預設在本機 9876 埠等指令，而且沒有密碼；能連上這個埠的程式，就能在 Blender 裡執行 Python。

scenes.title: 步驟：四步接上 Blender
scenes.screen: 裝 uv → 裝外掛、啟動 → codex mcp add → codex mcp list
scenes.objective: 能照四步把 Blender 接上 Codex，接好後先做唯讀檢查
scenes.narration: 實際接起來，只要四步。第一，安裝 uv，它會幫你下載並執行 MCP 伺服器；第二，安裝 Blender 外掛並啟用，在 3D 視窗按 N 打開側邊欄，到 MCP for Blender 分頁啟動伺服器；第三，在終端機輸入 codex mcp add blender，後面接 uvx mcp-for-blender；第四，輸入 codex mcp list，看到 blender 的狀態是 enabled，就接好了。這行指令，其實是把設定寫進 config.toml；Codex 桌面版、CLI 和 IDE 擴充都共用這份設定。接好之後，第一句先別急著改東西，先問它：場景裡現在有哪些物件？確定 Codex 真的看得到場景，再開始動手。

scenes.title: 比較：三種做法
scenes.screen: 同一任務：做一張木凳並算圖（比較原理與適用性，非效能實測）
scenes.objective: 能依任務需求在背景腳本、社群 MCP、官方 MCP 之間選擇
scenes.narration: 同一個任務：做一張木凳，再算一張圖。我們比比三種做法。背景腳本不需要外掛，也不用打開 Blender 視窗，最適合放進自動化流程；社群版 MCP for Blender 支援 Blender 3.0 以上，工具最多，還能搜尋素材、看截圖；官方 Blender Lab MCP 需要 Blender 5.1 以上，由 Blender 團隊維護；官方也提醒，它會直接執行 AI 寫的程式，沒有防護，建議在不放重要資料的電腦上使用。三種做法，最後都是執行 bpy 程式碼；差別在 Blender 要不要開著、能不能即時看到結果。要重複跑、要批次，選背景腳本；要邊看邊改，選 MCP。

scenes.title: 應用一：一句話建場景（示範）
scenes.title_en: Use case 1: a scene from one sentence (demo)
scenes.screen: 問題 → 過程 → 結果（Blender 5.2.1 實際算圖）→ 限制
scenes.objective: 看懂一句話建場景的問題、過程、結果與限制（實際算圖）
scenes.narration: 應用一，一句話建場景。需求是：做一個低多邊形的書房角落，有木桌、木凳和檯燈，暖色燈光，算一張圖。程式會把需求拆成物件、材質、燈光和相機四段，再交給 Blender 執行。這是本片示範，用 Blender 5.2 背景模式實際算出的第一版：物件都對了，但光線偏冷，檯燈也沒亮。再補一句：燈光暖一點，檯燈要亮。第二版，就有了溫暖的燈光。但問題也看得到：燈罩在牆上投出一大片奇怪的影子。比例、美感和細節，還是要人來判斷。

scenes.title: 應用二：批次整理＋安全
scenes.screen: 120 個 Cube… → Book_001–Book_120、同一材質、匯出 GLB（實測）
scenes.objective: 知道批次整理的實測效果與三個安全習慣
scenes.narration: 應用二，批次整理。匯入一批模型後，120 本書的名字都是 Cube、Cube.001、Cube.002 等等請 Codex 依位置排序，改名成 Book_001 到 Book_120，換上同一個材質，再匯出成 GLB。實測，Blender 背景模式連啟動在內約 13 秒，120 個物件全部改好，匯出一個 176 KB 的 GLB。這類會改檔案的工作，記得三件事：先存檔；社群版可以開 safe mode，擋下危險的程式；在 Codex 把工具核准模式設成 writes，會修改的工具先問過你。

scenes.title: 展望與回顧
scenes.screen: 已公布｜未解問題｜推測（截至 2026-10）
scenes.objective: 分辨已公布、未解問題與推測，回收 MCP 迴路
scenes.narration: 接下來會怎麼走？已經公布的是：Blender 官方 MCP 已經上架，Anthropic 也捐款，支持 Blender 繼續發展 Python API。還沒解決的是：AI 主要靠截圖和文字理解 3D，深度和比例容易看錯；直接執行程式碼，也有資料安全的風險。我們推測，會有更多創作軟體開放 MCP，讓說一句話、看結果、再修正，成為常見的工作方式。記住這個迴路：一句話、Python、MCP、Blender 執行、看截圖、再修正。下次打開 Blender，先請 Codex 數數看，場景裡有幾個物件吧。

text: 想用一句話，就在 Blender 裡蓋出一個場景嗎？
Want to build a Blender scene with a single sentence?
問題是，Codex 本來看不到 Blender，也按不到它的任何按鈕。
The problem is, Codex can't see Blender, and it can't press any of its buttons.
它需要一座橋。
It needs a bridge.
2024 年 11 月，Anthropic 提出 MCP，
In November 2024, Anthropic introduced MCP,
一種讓 AI 連接外部工具的開放標準；
an open standard for connecting AI to outside tools;
2025 年 3 月，社群開發者 Siddharth Ahuja 發布 BlenderMCP，
in March 2025, community developer Siddharth Ahuja released BlenderMCP,
讓 AI 透過外掛直接操作 Blender；
letting AI drive Blender through an add-on;
2026 年 4 月，Blender 官方團隊
and in April 2026, the Blender team
也推出了自己的 MCP 伺服器。
released an official MCP server of its own.
Codex 支援 MCP，所以這座橋，Codex 也能走。
Codex supports MCP, so Codex can cross this bridge too.
Codex 操控 Blender，有兩條路。
There are two roads for Codex to control Blender.
第一條是背景腳本：Codex 寫好一個 Python 檔，
The first is a background script: Codex writes a Python file
在終端機用 Blender 的背景模式執行它；
and runs it with Blender's background mode in the terminal;
Blender 不開視窗，跑完就結束。
no window opens, and Blender quits when it's done.
它適合批次、可以重複的工作，
It's great for batch, repeatable jobs,
但過程中你看不到畫面。
but you don't see anything along the way.
第二條是 MCP 即時連線：
The second is a live MCP connection:
Blender 開著，Codex 一邊下指令、一邊看結果；
Blender stays open, and Codex sends commands and watches the results;
適合邊做邊調整，
good for adjusting as you go,
代價是 Blender 必須開著，還要先裝好外掛。
at the cost of keeping Blender open with an add-on installed.
兩條路的核心都一樣：
Both roads share the same core:
Codex 寫 Python，交給 Blender 內建的 bpy 去執行。
Codex writes Python, and Blender's built-in bpy runs it.
你說一句話，Codex 就把它寫成 Python；
You say one sentence, and Codex writes it as Python;
MCP 把程式送進 Blender 裡的外掛，
MCP carries the code to an add-on inside Blender,
外掛執行程式，場景裡就長出物件；
the add-on runs it, and objects appear in the scene;
Codex 再看截圖檢查，
then Codex checks a screenshot,
哪裡不對，就再改一次。
and fixes whatever looks wrong.
MCP 伺服器提供的工具，
The tools the MCP server provides,
例如執行程式碼、讀取場景資訊、看視窗截圖，
like running code, reading scene info, and looking at the viewport,
就是 Codex 的手和眼睛。
are Codex's hands and eyes.
要注意，外掛預設在本機 9876 埠等指令，而且沒有密碼；
Be careful: by default the add-on listens on local port 9876 with no password;

scenes.title: 起源：Codex 需要一座橋
scenes.screen: 2024-11 MCP standard → March 2025 community BlenderMCP → April 2026 official Blender MCP
scenes.objective: 知道 Codex 本身看不到 Blender，需要 MCP 這座橋；記住 2025 年 3 月社群 BlenderMCP、2026 年 4 月官方 MCP
scenes.narration: Want to build a Blender scene with a single sentence? The problem is, Codex can't see Blender, and it can't press any of its buttons. It needs a bridge. In November 2024, Anthropic introduced MCP, an open standard for connecting AI to outside tools; in March 2025, community developer Siddharth Ahuja released BlenderMCP, letting AI drive Blender through an add-on; and in April 2026, the Blender team released an official MCP server of its own. Codex supports MCP, so Codex can cross this bridge too.

scenes.title: 原理一：兩條路
scenes.screen: Background script: hand Blender a .py | MCP: Blender stays open, work and watch
scenes.objective: 分辨背景腳本與 MCP 即時連線兩條路，並知道兩者核心都是 bpy
scenes.narration: There are two roads for Codex to control Blender. The first is a background script: Codex writes a Python file and runs it with Blender's background mode in the terminal; no window opens, and Blender quits when it's done. It's great for batch, repeatable jobs, but you don't see anything along the way. The second is a live MCP connection: Blender stays open, and Codex sends commands and watches the results; good for adjusting as you go, at the cost of keeping Blender open with an add-on installed. Both roads share the same core: Codex writes Python, and Blender's built-in bpy runs it.

scenes.title: 原理二：MCP 迴路
scenes.screen: One sentence → Python → MCP into the Blender add-on → run → screenshot → fix
scenes.objective: 能依序說出 MCP 迴路，並知道 9876 埠無密碼的風險
scenes.narration: You say one sentence, and Codex writes it as Python; MCP carries the code to an add-on inside Blender, the add-on runs it, and objects appear in the scene; then Codex checks a screenshot, and fixes whatever looks wrong. The tools the MCP server provides, like running code, reading scene info, and looking at the viewport, are Codex's hands and eyes. Be careful: by default the add-on listens on local port 9876 with no password; anything that can reach that port can run Python inside Blender.

scenes.title: 步驟：四步接上 Blender
scenes.screen: Install uv → install & start the add-on → codex mcp add → codex mcp list
scenes.objective: 能照四步把 Blender 接上 Codex，接好後先做唯讀檢查
scenes.narration: Hooking it up takes just four steps. One, install uv, which downloads and runs the MCP server for you; two, install and enable the Blender add-on, press N in the 3D viewport, and start the server from the MCP for Blender tab; three, in the terminal, type codex mcp add blender, followed by uvx mcp-for-blender; four, type codex mcp list, and when blender shows enabled, you're connected. That command actually writes the setting into config.toml, which the Codex desktop app, the CLI, and the IDE extension all share. Once connected, don't start changing things right away. First ask: what objects are in the scene right now? Make sure Codex can really see the scene before it starts working.

scenes.title: 比較：三種做法
scenes.screen: Same task: build a stool and render it (approach & fit, not a benchmark)
scenes.objective: 能依任務需求在背景腳本、社群 MCP、官方 MCP 之間選擇
scenes.narration: Same task: build a stool and render one image. Let's compare three ways. A background script needs no add-on and no open Blender window, so it fits best into automated pipelines; the community MCP for Blender supports Blender 3.0 and up, has the most tools, and can even search assets and take screenshots; the official Blender Lab MCP needs Blender 5.1 or newer and is maintained by the Blender team; its page warns that it runs AI-written code with no safeguards, so use a machine without sensitive data. All three end up running bpy code; the difference is whether Blender stays open and whether you see results live. For repeatable batch runs, pick a background script; to watch and tweak, pick MCP.

scenes.title_en: Use case 1: a scene from one sentence (demo)
scenes.screen: Problem → process → result (actual Blender 5.2.1 render) → limits
scenes.objective: 看懂一句話建場景的問題、過程、結果與限制（實際算圖）
scenes.narration: Use case one: a scene from one sentence. The request: a low-poly study corner with a wooden desk, a stool, and a desk lamp, warm lighting, and one rendered image. The code splits the request into four parts, objects, materials, lights, and camera, and hands them to Blender. This is our demo's first version, actually rendered in Blender 5.2 background mode: the objects are right, but the light is cool and the lamp isn't lit. One more sentence: warmer light, and turn the lamp on. Version two has a warm glow. But you can also see a problem: the lampshade throws a huge, odd shadow on the wall. Proportion, taste, and detail still need a human eye.

scenes.title: 應用二：批次整理＋安全
scenes.screen: 120 Cube… objects → Book_001–Book_120, one material, GLB export (measured)
scenes.objective: 知道批次整理的實測效果與三個安全習慣
scenes.narration: Use case two: batch cleanup. After an import, 120 books are named Cube, Cube.001, Cube.002, and so on. Ask Codex to sort them by position, rename them Book_001 to Book_120, give them one material, and export a GLB. In our test, Blender's background mode took about 13 seconds including startup, renamed all 120 objects, and exported a 176 KB GLB. For jobs that change files, remember three things: save first; turn on safe mode in the community add-on to block risky code; and set Codex's tool approval mode to writes, so tools that modify things ask you first.

scenes.title: 展望與回顧
scenes.screen: Announced | open problems | inference (as of Oct 2026)
scenes.objective: 分辨已公布、未解問題與推測，回收 MCP 迴路
scenes.narration: Where is this heading? Already announced: the official Blender MCP is out, and Anthropic donated to support Blender's work on its Python API. Still unsolved: AI mostly understands 3D through screenshots and text, so depth and scale are easy to misjudge; and running code directly carries data-safety risks. Our inference: more creative tools will open up to MCP, making say it, see it, fix it a common way to work. Remember the loop: one sentence, Python, MCP, Blender runs it, check the screenshot, fix it. Next time you open Blender, start by asking Codex to count the objects in your scene.
